content.short: Perimeter is a guild of world-class fuzzing specialists delivering high-quality fuzzing services to protocols.
content.description: Perimeter unites world-class fuzzing specialists to provide high-quality fuzzing services to protocols. The team brings extensive expertise in fuzzing a diverse range of protocols, from smaller, niche projects to some of the largest and most complex systems in DeFi. This breadth of experience across varied protocol scales supports rigorous fuzzing across ecosystems and helps address the security needs of the DeFi landscape. By drawing on a community of seasoned fuzzers, Perimeter emphasizes collaboration, quality, and thorough coverage.
